HostelMate

University hostel portal. Interactive Bad HCI design.

JUMP TO A SCREEN

Try it: type in any field. Login: any ID plus a password of 8+ characters opens the dashboard, anything else shows the error. Sign up needs all fields and matching 8+ character passwords. Updates: type a word (water, quiet, dining, laundry) and press Enter. Submit Complaint: pick category and location, describe the problem, then Submit. The menu icon on complaint screens opens Login (the bad flow). Use “Show clickable areas” to see every link.
